next.reason: 1985: "The INVALID KEY phrase must be specified in the REWRITE statement for relative files in the random or dynamic access mode"; 2023: "SR-14.9.35.3-2 only forbids INVALID KEY/NOT INVALID KEY for sequential access; no rule requires INVALID KEY absent a USE procedure". The 2023 REWRITE syntax rules cover INVALID KEY only to forbid it in sequential access. None requires it for random/dynamic relative files without a USE procedure, so such programs are now accepted.
